AUTHOR: Saleh
TITLE: Overcoming annotation bottlenecks in underwater fish segmentation: a robust self-supervised learning approach
REGION: Tropical Australia (DeepFish, training); Australian estuaries (Seagrass, test); YouTube-VOS fish videos (test)
SPECIES: fish (class-agnostic video object segmentation); Seagrass set = Girella tricuspidata
DATA: DeepFish (self-supervised training), Luderick-Seagrass (4280 frames), YouTube-VOS fish subset (130 videos, 4349 frames)

R_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'The feature extractor was trained on DeepFish and evaluated on Seagrass and YouTube-VOS.' (no in-domain DeepFish result reported)
C_EV: no statement found (only 'an IoU threshold of 0.5' for recall metrics)
E_EV: Sec. 3.4: 'This study reports the mean average of J&F, as well as the mean and recall of Jm and Fm'
ARCH: Self-supervised CoaT Transformer encoder + MLP with cross-view consistency and space-time self-training; kNN label propagation from first-frame mask
METR: Jaccard index (J), Dice/F, J&F mean, recall
